claims.statement: The Northgate Business Park lease premises comprise approximately 92,000 rentable square feet, located in Building A, Suites 100–450, along with 220 surface parking spaces and non-exclusive use of a shared loading area.

citations.quote: The premises consist of approximately 92,000 rentable square feet across Building A, Suites 100–450, together with 220 surface parking spaces and non-exclusive use of the shared loading area on the east side of the property.

claims.statement: This figure is consistent with the anchor tenant's stated share of the property: the anchor tenant leases 62% of the net rentable area, and 92,000 SF is approximately 62% of the 148,500 SF total building area reported for the property in the comparable transaction data.

citations.quote: The anchor tenant, Vantage Fulfillment Co., leases 62% of the net rentable area
